## CombinationsGenerator.matrixKeys property

The array of parameter names.

**Signature:**

```typescript
protected readonly matrixKeys: string[];
```

## Remarks

This array contains the names of all matrix parameters in the order they should be processed during combination generation. Each key corresponds to a parameter that will appear in the generated combinations.
